subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw take ownership of a bundled first-party Wear OS companion app now, or defer/close this branch until an Android owner sponsors the feature with the required security, CI, license, and proof work?
rationale: The branch is a broad new first-party app surface rather than a narrow bug fix; automation can identify concrete blockers, but it cannot decide whether OpenClaw wants to own the Wear app product/security/support surface.

options.title: Sponsor after blockers are fixed
options.body: Keep this PR open only if an Android owner is willing to own the Wear OS surface after the P1/P2 findings, rebase, and proof gaps are resolved.

options.title: Defer first-party Wear ownership
options.body: Close or pause this branch and invite a smaller future proposal if maintainers do not want a bundled Wear app yet.

options.title: Extract a smaller Android gateway seam
options.body: Ask for a narrower PR that lands shared gateway/proxy primitives first, leaving the Wear app itself for a later owner-sponsored branch.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after blockers are fixed
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if an Android owner is willing to own the Wear OS surface after the P1/P2 findings, rebase, and proof gaps are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus is the live assignee and has recent Android gateway/talk ownership signals, making them the best available owner for the product-direction call.
